handoff: Route lanes now answer the player. Draw-in: a lane made now grows from its source end (alpha reach, width 35% to 100%, soft leading edge), 0.25 s, ease-out cubic; dots and chevron fade with it. Removal: the lane fades 0.15 s (ease in), tag hidden at once, then frees itself. Dispatch: when the ship count on a lane rises, one brightening band (alpha boost + toward white) runs source to destination in 0.5 s. All tunables are constants at the top of route_line.gd (DRAW_*, FADE_SECONDS, PULSE_*) and scale with Juice.motion (0 = off). Game time only: advances with time_speed, and a paused game snaps to the end state (lane fully drawn, no band, removed lane freed at once), so nothing is ever left half drawn. Hooks: map.gd set_routes calls line.draw_in() only for route ids above the highest seen (first call after a load and rebuilds do not animate) and line.fade_out() instead of queue_free on removal; route_line.set_style pulses when ships rises (first style from the map sets the count silently). Shader gained uniforms draw, fade, pulse_*; look at rest is unchanged.
